_description: Age 72 — RMD does not apply. Traditional-only portfolio with no spending should stay flat at 0% return.
_rationale: SECURE 2.0 RMD starts at 73. At 72 the table is not engaged even though the IRS table has a row for 72. Verify rmdRequired=0 and rmdExcess=0 for all years, and that the portfolio balance is exactly the starting Traditional balance each year.
name: RMD No Effect Below 73
